label: Gantt chart
intent: The project schedule is laid out on the Gantt chart: each task bar extends from its start date to its end date, in order. Light: the three bars grow out one after another, each starting while the one above is still running, and stop dead on their end dates. Strong: the bars run as a dependency chain: each one shoots out and stops with a hit, and the next starts only when the one above lands. The axis never moves.

bar-1.//: b1 1 = the bar collapsed to a dot at its start date
